questions.question: Which description fits the **Questionnaire** resource?
options: A structured set of questions intended to guide the collection of answers from end-users.
A kind of specimen with associated set of requirements.
This resource provides a reusable description of when a particular event can occur.
The characteristics, operational status and capabilities of a medical-related component of a medical device.
questions.explanation: **Questionnaire**: A structured set of questions intended to guide the collection of answers from end-users. Questionnaires provide detailed control over order, presentation, phraseology and grouping to allow coherent, consistent data collection. The other descriptions belong to **SpecimenDefinition**, **EventDefinition**, **DeviceDefinition**.

questions.question: Which resource would you use? The PHQ-9 depression screening form, with its questions and answer options.
questions.explanation: **Questionnaire**. The form definition. Answers go in QuestionnaireResponse.

questions.question: You know **Questionnaire**. Which resource should you use instead when you need “the completed answers”?
questions.explanation: **QuestionnaireResponse**: the completed answers. **Questionnaire** is for something else: A structured set of questions intended to guide the collection of answers from end-users.

questions.question: Which element is **required** (minimum cardinality 1) in every **Questionnaire** instance?
questions.explanation: The required top-level elements of Questionnaire are `status` (1..1). The other options have a minimum cardinality of 0, so they are optional.

questions.question: Which element of **Questionnaire** is a **modifier** (?!), so receiving systems must not ignore it?
questions.explanation: Modifier elements of Questionnaire: `status`. `status`: draft | active | retired | unknown. A modifier can change the meaning of the whole resource: for example, a status of `entered-in-error` means the data must not be used.
